explanation: click_ctx_free(ctx) is called when the widget is hidden or disabled, but execution continues. ctx->x, ctx->y, and ctx->widget are then written on freed memory. Clicking a hidden or disabled widget triggers this UAF.

timer_free(t) is called when the delay is zero or too large, but execution continues. t->expires, t->callback, and t->data are then written on freed memory. Scheduling a timer with an invalid delay triggers this UAF.

resize_event_free(ev) is called when dimensions are invalid, but execution continues. ev->old_w, ev->old_h, ev->new_w, and ev->new_h are then written on freed memory. Resizing a window to zero or negative dimensions triggers this UAF.

connection_free(conn) is called when the signal is blocked, but execution continues. conn->fn, conn->obj, and conn->id are then written on freed memory. Connecting a slot to a blocked signal triggers this UAF.

frame_free(frame) is called when the scene is empty, but execution continues. frame->width, frame->height, and frame->data are then written on freed memory. Rendering an empty scene triggers this UAF.

shortcut_free(sc) is called when the key or callback is invalid, but execution continues. sc->key, sc->action, and sc->active are then written on freed memory. Registering a keyboard shortcut with a null key or callback triggers this UAF.

drag_op_free(op) is called when the payload size is invalid, but execution continues. op->source, op->payload, op->size, and op->state are then written on freed memory. Starting a drag-and-drop with an empty or oversized payload triggers this UAF.
menu_item_free(item) is called when the menu is full, but execution continues. strncpy and subsequent field writes access freed item memory. Adding an item to a full menu triggers this UAF.

scroll_state_free(st) is called when the view is not scrollable in either direction, but execution continues. st->delta_x, st->delta_y, and st->velocity are then written on freed memory. Scrolling a non-scrollable view triggers this UAF.

animation_free(anim) is called when the duration is zero or target is null, but execution continues. anim->target, anim->duration, anim->easing, and anim->start_t are then written on freed memory. Starting an animation with no duration or target triggers this UAF.
